title: Skill manifest — cartografo
description: The contract for entering the capability registry (D4, D9). See especificacoes/formatos/skill-manifest.md.

id.description: the skill's stable identifier; unique in the registry

version.description: the skill's semver; it moves with every diff approved at the human gate

hash.description: the content pin (D4): sha256 of the canonical JSON serialization of {instructions, input, output, checks, permissions, budgets}

role.description: work = produces an artifact; gate = checks another node's artifact

description.description: one line; it is what the synthesizer reads when it queries the capability registry

input.description: a valid JSON Schema document (validated separately against the official meta-schema)

output.description: a valid JSON Schema document; for role=gate it has to include an outcome field with the enum ["pass","fail","escalate_human"]

preconditions.description: what has to be true of the state before dispatching; the executor checks it before opening a session

checks.description: the typed verification of what the skill produces (D9)

instructions.description: the body in Markdown; it may carry {{input.<path>}} placeholders, resolved by the runner before injection

id.description: stable within the skill; it is the key the telemetry aggregates the check by

command.description: a deterministic check: exit 0 = passed; anything else = failed

instruction.description: an agentic check: the judgement asked for, including the demand for evidence of its own

required_evidence.description: the artifacts the verdict has to cite; without them the check does not conclude

budgets.description: the execution ceilings the skill declares for itself; every axis is optional, and what is not declared inherits the server's ceiling. A skill only shortens its own leash: declaring more than the ceiling does not lengthen it

timeout_s.description: wall clock, in seconds; past it the session is killed

silence_s.description: seconds with no output at all before the session is considered stalled; the clock restarts on every output

reviewed_by.description: who signed the import gate (D4); a person, never an agent
